data.name: Mihik
data.gender_notes: Mihik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mihika’, which means ‘thought’, ‘intelligence’, or ‘intellect’. In Hindu mythology, Mihik is the name of a god associated with the intellect and learning. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer a sharp mind and a deep understanding of the world. The name Mihik carries the meaning “Intellect, thought” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mihik usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, thought and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Mihik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, thought.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mihik total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
